answer: To defeat Sybil swarms, the network enforces quadratic stake burning for concurrent identity registrations: creating the n-th identity requires burning an exponentially scaled fee proportional to n^2 in opal tokens. This mathematical superlinear cost imposes severe economic friction, pushing attackers off a financial ledge. Each agent voyage into consensus demands cryptographic proof of irreversible asset destruction, making mass fake identities computationally and economically ruinous.
